note: Scripture source: the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB 2017, Biblica, CC BY-SA), parsed from the ebible mirror's USX (bibles/lug_bib), all 66 books (31,104 verses). Translators looked up every quotation and close echo, cited or not, in that verse file.
Translated from the English as this PR settles it: 13 OCR slips repaired in BODY_CORRECTIONS (the Luganda renders the repaired sense).

Derived by measurement: a row is mined only when the translator reported the quotation verbatim AND its block contains a 30-character run of the OLCB verse (or a quoted span of 10+ characters that is a substring of it), compared with punctuation stripped. Adapted and self-rendered rows, and 3 unconfirmed verbatim claims, are self_rendered. 80 of 494 rows mined. Baxter quotes mostly from memory and bends verses into his own sentences, so most rows are adaptations.

Conventions: quotation marks mirror this book's English source (curly single quotes, plus the source's few straight doubles; no guillemets); in-word apostrophe ’ as OLCB; the refrain 'Take heed to yourselves' (Acts 20:28) is OLCB's Mwekumenga throughout; site terms Bayibuli, Setaani, Omukristaayo, ggeyeena; minister = omuweereza, pastor = omusumba, the flock = ekisibo, overseers = abalabirizi (OLCB). Title Omusumba Omuzzeemu Obuggya matches the shipped key-teachings-of-richard-baxter.lg. A whole-book pass checked trap words (Kitaawe, balubaale, muzimu, Mukama + surname: 0; mu bwangu x9 all hurriedly/hastily/readily in the English; okuvumirira x2 = condemn sin) and the r/l, -bwa and tripled-letter spelling rules (0 findings).
